text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On one of our days off, Symboli Rudolf<n>and I go out
in search of some skin<n>cream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No such luck... I should have expected<n>as much.
This brand only ships by<n>direct order.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Usually I track how much I have left<n>and order
more before I run out...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But Teio insisted on trying some, and<n>it seems I
gave her more than I<n>intended.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She seemed so delighted with one<n>bottle, I
couldn't resist giving her<n>more...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And now I am breaking out. The price<n>of my own
negligence, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems as if Symboli Rudolf is<n>having skincare
troubles.
